title: Duty and Probability in Medical Decisions
grammar: Recap: probability adverbs, and why probability is not duty
goal: I can tell what is likely from what is a duty (*minden bizonnyal sikeres*, *etikai kötelesség*).
I can use probability adverbs about a treatment (*feltehetőleg*, *minden bizonnyal*).
I can say that a treatment needs the patient's informed consent (*tájékozott beleegyezés*).
